_doc: NEXA-M2-004 embedding candidates. The evaluation (v1/tools/knowledge_embed_eval.py) builds one index per candidate through the Model Gateway. Register each logical name in the gateway (merge v1/model_gateway/models.embedding-candidates.json) and `ollama pull` each tag on the DGX first. Pin exact tags: the tag is the model version recorded on every index.

candidates.why: Multilingual successor to the incumbent; 512-token context.
Multilingual, 8K context, widely used retrieval baseline.
bge-m3 served on the CPU (num_gpu 0): on the DGX GPU, Ollama's bge-m3 intermittently returns NaN (2 of 56 questions). CPU serving also matches the school edge, which has no GPU.
Small multilingual model aimed at on-device use; Gemma licence terms.
Small multilingual instruction-following embedder, long context.
Strong English-only model: shows what multilinguality costs or gains.
Smallest edge floor; 256-token context, expected to truncate.
Central-only upper bound; too large for school servers.
